summary.text: Ken Borton is the Republican state representative for Michigan House District 105, which he has held since January 1, 2021, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists him as a business owner who lives in Gaylord, Michigan.

paragraphs.text: Ken Borton earned a degree in advanced Bible study and Biblical counseling from Liberty University, according to Ballotpedia.
His career experience includes owning a business, and he oversaw the Michigan Association of Counties in Lansing and the Northern Michigan Counties Association.
Borton took office in the state House in 2021, succeeding Triston Cole.

He has been assigned to the House Appropriations Committee in each term since 2021, and for 2025-2026 he was also Majority Vice Chair of the Select Committee on Protecting Michigan Employees and Small Businesses.
